featured_reviews.name: Sukanya
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Fresh Press is a clean, health-focused café known for smoothie bowls, fresh juices, and light meals. The place has a simple, fresh vibe and is popular for quick, wholesome options.

Here's what I tried:
1. Mix Berry Smoothie Bowl – Fresh and nicely balanced, with a good mix of sweetness and tang. Enjoyable and filling.
2. Pineapple Cut Fruit – Unfortunately, not very ripe and lacked sweetness, so it wasn’t very enjoyable.
3. Watermelon Cut Fruit – Also disappointing; not sweet and lacked freshness.
4. Cheese Chutney Sandwich – Simple, comforting, and well-made. A good choice for a light meal.
5. Mango Smoothie Bowl – Creamy, sweet, and satisfying. Ordered it again because it was genuinely good.
6. Spinach Corn Sandwich – Mild, wholesome, and filling. Works well if you want something light yet nourishing.
7. Watermelon Juice – Refreshing but could have been sweeter; felt slightly bland.

featured_reviews.name: Prajakta Chorge
featured_reviews.review_text: If you're looking for a cute, cozy café, this spot is perfect for relaxing with a comforting cup of coffee paired with delicious, must-try snacks.

featured_reviews.name: Manideepa Mahato
featured_reviews.review_text: Blue Tokai is my favourite coffee brand. Every cup feels special and it has become a part of many of my best moments. The coffee is constantly excellent and makes ordinary days feel a little more memorable.

featured_reviews.name: Priti Ashar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this Blue Tokai outletat Chembur East and was immediately struck by the beautiful ambience. It has a rare, homely atmosphere that makes you want to linger over your coffee for hours.
The highlight of the decor is undoubtedly the stunning Gond art. These intricate murals beautifully depict the essence and beauty of India, adding a soulful, cultural touch to the modern cafe setting.
What truly made my visit memorable, however, was the exceptional hospitality. A special shout-out to Mohammad Imran, who attended to us with such warmth and professionalism. His attentive service perfectly complemented the cozy vibes of the place.
Whether you're looking for a peaceful spot to work or a warm corner to catch up with friends, this cafe is a must-visit for its perfect blend of art, coffee, and heart.

featured_reviews.name: Deepank Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: A hidden gem, plenty of options to choose from. The Google location is slightly confusing, it’s basically opposite to the apollo hospital so it’s best to put the hospital’s location rather than going by the Google pinned location. The food was top notch, it took a bit of time to get it ready but it was worth the wait. The coffee was fabulous as ever. Great for brunch or solo dates and the fact that it’s slightly away from the road helps you relax.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Very cute outlet, their cinnamon rolls are a must try, and so is the Vietnamese coffee!
Service was okay

featured_reviews.name: Dr. Oindrila De
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent coffee by Blue Tokai & incredible bread & baked goods from Suchali's Artisanal Bakehouse. You can learn about coffee harvesting, roasting and flavor development from the experts at Blue Tokai. Staff is extremely warm & welcoming. Love visiting this place. Perfect for a coffee date or brunch. Can't wait to visit again. Highly recommend it!

featured_reviews.name: Shivraj Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Blue Tokai, and while I acknowledge its potential for growth and development, my overall experience fell short of expectations. Known for their exceptional coffee and food, this particular outlet failed to provide the warm and inviting atmosphere I have come to associate with the brand. Here's a breakdown of my visit:

Ambiance:
Unfortunately, the cafe lacked the inviting ambiance that I have experienced at other Blue Tokai locations. The atmosphere felt somewhat cold and impersonal, leaving much to be desired in terms of comfort and coziness.

Service:
The staff's training and courtesy left room for improvement. It seemed that they could benefit from better training to ensure a more customer-oriented approach. The lack of attentiveness and overall politeness detracted from the overall experience. This is does not apply for all the staff but for a few among them.

Food and Coffee:
The one shining aspect of my visit was the quality of the food and coffee. Blue Tokai is well-known for their excellent coffee, and it lived up to its reputation at this location as well. The food, too, was commendable and met my expectations in terms of taste and presentation.

Service Incident:
Regrettably, my experience was marred by an incident that occurred during my visit. Despite specifically ordering a combo, I did not receive the combo. To add to the disappointment, I was later asked to pay extra for the item. This lack of attention to detail and the subsequent inconvenience significantly impacted my overall perception of the cafe.

In conclusion, Blue Tokai has the potential to become a great cafe, but there are several areas that need improvement. While the coffee and food were commendable, the lackluster ambiance, poorly trained staff, and the service mishap prevented me from giving it a higher rating. I sincerely hope that Blue Tokai addresses these issues to provide a better experience for future customers.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Chhaya
featured_reviews.review_text: A great place in Chembur if you enjoy quality coffee. They have snacks that compliment coffee well, too like Croissant , brownies, cookies, Sandwiches, Pasta. Ambience is friendly & functional, which occassional sound of the coffee grinder, with a constant aroma of quality Arabica coffee.
